title: My account
subtitle: Your profile, sign-in details and data.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name shows on your account and in emails, not on your resumes. Your username shows when you share a template.
profile.name: Full name

username.label: Username
username.hint: Shown as the owner of templates you make public, and used for your profile address. 3–30 characters; lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
username.format: Use only lowercase English letters, digits, - and _; start with a letter and don't end with - or _.
username.reserved: This username is reserved; choose another.
username.taken: This username is taken; choose another.

email.title: Email address
email.description: You sign in with this address and our emails go to it.
email.howItWorks: The change takes two steps: first an approval link goes to your current address, then a verification link to the new one. Your address changes when you click the second link.
email.sent: We sent an approval link to {email}. Once you approve, a verification link goes to your new address.
email.changed: Your email address is updated and verified.
email.linkInvalid: The link has expired or was already used. Start the change again.

password.title: Password
password.description: When you change your password, every session except this one is signed out.
password.setDescription: You sign in only with Google right now. Set a password to also sign in with your email and password.
password.hint: At least 10 characters. A long sentence is easy to remember and strong.
password.changed: Your password changed; sessions on other devices were signed out.
password.set: Your password is set. You can now also sign in with your email and password.
password.failed: Couldn’t change the password; check your current password.
password.tooShort: The new password must be at least 10 characters.

methods.title: Sign-in methods
methods.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Google? From now on you sign in with your email and password.
methods.disconnectNeedsPassword: Set a password before disconnecting, or you won’t be able to sign in.

sessions.title: Open sessions
sessions.description: Devices signed in to your account. If you see one you don’t recognise, sign it out and change your password.
sessions.revokeOthersConfirm: Sign out every session except this one?
sessions.othersRevoked: Your other sessions were signed out.
sessions.onlyThis: You’re signed in only on this device.

data.title: My data
data.description: Download everything stored in your account (profile, resumes and their versions, consents, reviews) as one JSON file. Your password and session keys are never included.

close.title: Close account
close.description: Your resumes and their versions are deleted for good, your personal details are anonymised and you are signed out. This can’t be undone; download your data first.
close.admin: Admin or editor accounts can’t be closed here; the role must be removed first.
close.confirm: Type your e-mail address to confirm ({email})
